alignments.note: Rule 9: the auxiliary rides with the inflected verb and the lexical verb heads.
Rule 32: a substantival article before a participle supplies the pronoun and nothing else; the dative case preposition rides along under rule 21 and rule 17 heads on the pronoun.
Rule 32: the participle carries the supplied relativizer; rule 73's collapse does not apply because the ASV spells both elements of hetoimos echo out.
Rule 61: no conjunction governs the infinitive, so the marker is its verb's own helper.
Rule 58: the Greek is anarthrous and the substantival participle takes the supplied determiner itself.
Rule 58: a substantival adjective is the nominal word and takes the supplied determiner.
